answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making influence path-dependent. Each identity begins with near-zero weight and must earn seals from independent graders on original epoch work. Only a sustained pulse of those seals unlocks committee power. On the public reef of answers, accounts that merely echo one draft form a tight similarity cluster; the jury can score that cluster as a single author and leave the copies unattested, so extra keys cannot multiply votes or reward share.
